job.description: job name; new jobs must start with VP_JOB_PREFIX (vpops)

rt.description: runtime root of the multi-agent capsule (VP_SWARM_RT); never under /dev/shm/vqa-cu/hybrid/ without allow_hybrid

to.description: a point id or the literal last_good

reason.description: one line, stored in the log

resume.description: resume the broker after a matching restore

dry_run.description: print the receipt with data.argv (what would run) and start nothing

timeout_s.description: deadline of the call; on expiry the child is stopped by PID and rc is 124

confirm.description: required unless dry_run: must equal the value of `to` (a point id or `last_good`)

tools.wraps: VP_SWARM_NONCE=<nonce> python3 -I $VP_REF/ref_rewind_demo/rewindctl.py rewind --job J --rt RT --to POINT|last_good [--reason R] [--resume]
